subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild channel allowlists accept name globs, and if so what precedence and ambiguity rules should apply relative to exact channel, thread-parent, and literal `*` entries?
rationale: The choice changes which Discord messages and interactions cross an authorization boundary, and several reasonable syntax and precedence designs cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Add ordered name globs
options.body: Support documented slug patterns after exact and thread-parent matching but before literal `*`, with deterministic specificity and explicit tie handling.

options.title: Prefer category inheritance
options.body: Decline arbitrary name globs and use the category-level policy tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60582 for dynamic channel groups.

options.title: Keep exact allowlists
options.body: Retain exact id/name/slug entries plus literal `*` and require explicit configuration for each newly authorized channel.

recommendation.title: Add ordered name globs
recommendation.body: Support documented slug patterns after exact and thread-parent matching but before literal `*`, with deterministic specificity and explicit tie handling.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and unified the shared matcher whose authorization precedence would need to be extended or deliberately preserved.
